title: Architecture orientation
prompt: Read CLAUDE.md and the three agent-harness plan docs. Summarise the project's North Star in three bullets: target, engine, structure. Include one sentence per bullet about what the substrate would look like if the falsifiable claim held.
criteria: user_confirms=summary captures the manifesto's three principles in priority order

title: Closed-loop trace
prompt: Walk through how a single UserPromptSubmit flows from the prompt string through the daemon to a re-ranked recall result. Cite each module that touches the request and what it does. Stop when an injection block reaches stdout.
criteria: user_confirms=trace covers user_prompt → daemon → rank → rerank → injection format

title: Eval baseline read
prompt: Run `rlat memory eval --sessions 7` against this workspace. Explain why each axis reads what it does. If useful_axis is 0.0, explain the precise reason from the artifacts on disk.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=eval CLI runs
user_confirms=explanation grounded in what exists in .rlat-state/

title: Eval --since / --until
prompt: Add `--since ISO` and `--until ISO` flags to `rlat memory eval` so an operator can pick an explicit time window instead of the daily-window default. Default behaviour unchanged.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/memory.py
user_confirms=both flags work; absent → default daily-window behaviour

title: Skill description audit
prompt: Open every SKILL.md under .claude/skills/{want,accept,reject,workspace,what-next,decompose,intent-interrogate}. Flag any description that wouldn't reliably trigger the skill on a natural-language prompt. Suggest a one-line description fix for each.
criteria: user_confirms=audit finds at least 1 trigger weakness or affirms all 7 are well-shaped

title: Lift _user_error
prompt: `_user_error` is duplicated in cli/intent.py and cli/memory.py. Lift it to a shared cli/_errors.py and update both callers.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/intent.py src/resonance_lattice/cli/memory.py

title: Forget condition 4 trigger semantics
prompt: Architecture says forget condition 4 fires on corpus drift but doesn't specify partial drift behaviour: if a row cites 5 passages and 1 has drifted, does the row demote? Decide; document; sketch the implementation surface.
criteria: user_confirms=decision with stated rationale; sketch identifies which module owns the check

title: rlat intent path
prompt: Add `rlat intent path <intent_id>` that walks parent_ids upward and prints the chain (root → leaf). Works across the live store and durable store; cross-store traversal is fine.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/intent.py
user_confirms=walks the chain correctly

title: Daily-window edge case
prompt: `daily_windows(n=20, end_iso=now)` floors `end_iso` to midnight and walks back N days. That means today's activity never appears in the default eval. Decide if that's intentional. If not, fix.
criteria: user_confirms=decision documented; if fix, harness suite contract added/updated

title: Live vs durable intent
prompt: Write a 5-sentence newcomer explanation of why intent rows split across the live store (.rlat-state/intent/) and the durable memory store (~/.rlat/memory/). Explain the cutoff between task and goal.
criteria: user_confirms=explanation reads correctly to someone new to the codebase

title: Architecture vs implementation
prompt: For each of memory/distil_arrow{1,2,3}.py, cross-check the cited architecture sections against actual behaviour. Flag any drift between spec and code.
criteria: user_confirms=at least one finding (spec drift OR confirmation of fidelity for each arrow)

title: Intent list JSON
prompt: Add `--json` flag to `rlat intent list` and `rlat intent durable` for downstream tooling. Output is the intent dict shape. No schema additions.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/intent.py

title: Shared CLI memory helper
prompt: `_open_user_memory` and `_workspace_polarity_tag` are defined in cli/intent.py but used implicitly by other CLI subcommands too. Move to cli/_memory.py and import where used.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/intent.py src/resonance_lattice/cli/memory.py

title: Planning-mode-listening surface
prompt: Architecture wants a planning-mode-listening hook to capture Claude Code planning-mode output as intent rows. Claude Code's published hook events don't include planning mode boundaries. Sketch an approach: post-hoc transcript parsing OR wait for Anthropic OR something else. Pick one with rationale.
criteria: user_confirms=approach picked with explicit rationale on cost vs robustness

title: Memory eval secondary signal
prompt: Why does `secondary_memory_depth_by_level` show only `event` rows in this workspace right now? Trace it back to which writers populate the store. Identify which path is missing.
criteria: user_confirms=root cause identified, not just symptom

title: Consolidate dry-run
prompt: Add `--dry-run` to `rlat memory consolidate` that runs the pipeline but skips writes; reports what would have changed.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/memory.py
user_confirms=dry-run output matches a real run's plan

title: Confidence raising for newcomers
prompt: Document mechanism 1 + 5 in plain language: how does a memory row get its confidence raised, when does it cap at high vs verified, and what makes a principle different from a learning here?
criteria: user_confirms=explanation matches what memory/confidence.py actually does

title: Cross-suite harness audit
prompt: Run `python -m tests.harness.runner --all` (UTF-8 enforced) and find any suite that's flaky, slow, or skipped. Document findings. Don't fix unless trivially obvious.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --all
user_confirms=audit document with at least one observation

title: Session-id markers
prompt: Add `rlat memory session-mark` that writes a session boundary timestamp to `.rlat-state/ledger/sessions.jsonl`. Update `daily_windows` to optionally slice by session_id when markers exist.
criteria: mechanical:exit_code:0=python -m tests.harness.runner --changed src/resonance_lattice/cli/memory.py src/resonance_lattice/state/eval.py
user_confirms=session boundaries respected by eval

title: Horizon 4 sketch
prompt: Given Horizons 1, 2, and substrate of 3 are now landed, sketch what Horizon 4 should focus on. Cover one user-facing surface, one substrate primitive, one operational concern. Keep each to 3 sentences.
criteria: user_confirms=Horizon 4 sketch is concrete enough to break into goals
